Which statement about methane is correct?
A
In methane, positive hydrogen ions are attracted to negative carbon ions.
B
In methane, electrons are shared between carbon atoms and hydrogen atoms.
C
Methane has a high boiling point.
D
Methane is a good conductor of electricity.

options.label: A
options.text: In methane, positive hydrogen ions are attracted to negative carbon ions.

options.label: B
options.text: In methane, electrons are shared between carbon atoms and hydrogen atoms.

options.label: C
options.text: Methane has a high boiling point.

options.label: D
options.text: Methane is a good conductor of electricity.
